title: Spelling changes and irregular forms
intro: Read this before the questions on spelling and irregular adjectives.

blocks.title: spelling changes
items: Adjective ending in **e**: add only **r** / **st**: large, **larger**, **the largest**; nice, **nicer**.
One vowel + one consonant: **double the consonant**: big, **bigger**, **the biggest**; hot, **hotter**; thin, **thinner**.
Consonant + y: y becomes **i**: easy, **easier**, **the easiest**; busy, **busier**.

blocks.title: the slips
items: These forms are different words, not -er forms: **good** has no *gooder*.
